name: BricksVR
description: BricksVR is a multiplayer sandbox building game in VR in early access. - Invite friends to a shared world and build creations together. Shared worlds include voice chat, physics, and the ability to save progress. - You're not limited by what's in the box in BricksVR.

name: Battle talent
description: Fight like a Warrior: Dive into a challenging physics-based roguelite action game set in a medieval fantasy world. Create your unique fighting style and embark on epic adventures!

name: Clone Drone in The Hyperdome
description: You are Blink, a teleporting robot who is the newest “looprunner” gladiator to compete in the Crashloop, a deadly roguelike tournament to the death.

name: Blackforge A Smithing Adventure
description: BlackForge: A Smithing Adventure is the ultimate VR weaponsmithing simulator! Become a legendary blacksmith, crafting mighty blades and impeccable tools as you hone your trade in a mystical forge.

name: Workshop Simulater
description: Workshop Simulator VR is a simulation game where you take on the role of a workshop owner, equipped with a range of specialized tools. Become a master of restoring various items, take on increasingly complex tasks, earn money, build your reputation, buy new tools, replenish resources, and expand your workshop.

name: Bonelab
description: BONELAB is an experimental physics action game. Explore a mysterious lab filled with weapons, enemies, challenges and secrets. Escape your reality, or wreak havoc. No wrong answers.

name: Tactical Assault VR
description: Tactical Assault VR is an intense tactical shooter where you use real-world CQB (Close Quarters Battles) tactics to stack up, breach doors and eliminate threats. Play solo or join an online co-op special forces unit in missions around the world.
